Frontend manager-side verified end-to-end (refund/void buttons, labour widget, staff pay-type selector, role gating). TimeClock camera empty-state CTA verified. Cashier cart panel — tip/coupon/email/loyalty inputs not surfaced in headless automation runs (cart-total + pay-btn ARE rendered, so panel itself is mounted; items may not have actually been added by test). critical.issue: Both endpoints returned 500 'Internal server error' because the `_log()` helper in routes/refunds.py returned the doc that motor.insert_one() had mutated to include MongoDB's ObjectId `_id`, breaking FastAPI's JSON serialization. FIXED by popping `_id` from doc before returning.

rca of the issue: Production bug fixed: in /app/backend/routes/refunds.py the `_log()` helper returned the dict passed to `db.refund_logs.insert_one(doc)`. The motor (PyMongo) driver mutates the dict in-place to set `_id = ObjectId(...)`. Because both /orders/{id}/refund and /orders/{id}/void include this log dict in their JSON response, FastAPI's jsonable_encoder hit `'ObjectId' object is not iterable` and the request 500'd. Reproduction: POST /api/orders/{any-paid-order}/refund with {amount: 100, reason: 'x'} as Manager → 500. Fix: `doc.pop('_id', None)` after insert_one, before return. Verified by re-running the pytest suite — 29/29 pass.
